work.composition: framed plane swarm with disc descent
work.description: A red-bordered frame holds a flock of top-down warplane drawings; three silver compact discs scale across the field. Vertical orange stripes drip down the white ground; a green X on a purple square anchors the centre, with target rings and a magenta football along the base. Inscribed 'XXIII DBS' lower right.
work.title: XXIII Discs
